# Parent Playbook

> A free web app for parents of youth athletes (ages 3–19). It builds a weekly,
> age-appropriate at-home training plan around the team's existing practice and game
> schedule, and keeps a private record of the child's sporting life.

Parent Playbook is aimed at the parent who wants to help on non-practice days but has
never played the sport. Every activity explains what it is, why it matters, what to
say, and when to stop. Plans are age-banded and rest-first: the more the team trains
in a given week, the less the app adds at home.

## Pages
- [Home](https://playbookbp.com/): the marketing page and the app itself — the app boots in place at `#app`.
- [Privacy Policy](https://playbookbp.com/privacy): what is collected about a child and why, and how to delete it.
- [Terms of Service](https://playbookbp.com/terms)

## What it does
- Weekly plan: seven days of skill work, age-safe strength, game day and real rest, generated from the child's age, sport, position, goals and team schedule.
- Parent guidance: per-activity how-to, common mistakes, what to say, and stop signs.
- Athlete journey: game log with scores and stats, milestones, and a private photo/video gallery.
- Growth tracking: height and weight over time — a fast growth spurt reduces the week's training load automatically.
- Sharing: invite a co-parent, grandparent or coach; access can be revoked at any time.
- Installs to a phone home screen as a PWA. No app store, free to start, no card.

## What it is not
- Not medical, nutrition or physical-therapy advice.
- Not a social network. Nothing about a child is public or shareable to social platforms.
- Not a scouting, recruiting or ranking service.
